name: AstraCube
storyline:
AstraCube is a voxel survival game where every planet is a cube. You crash on an alien world with a wrecked ship, a journal, and not much else. Mine and craft your way from bare hands to stone tools, metal, power and machines, then rebuild your ship and fly between the planets of your solar system, and beyond.

Every world is generated from its seed: its own ground, plants, weather, animals and ores. Walk over the edge of a cube and the ground becomes the wall. Live with the people of each world: villages of six different races who work, sleep, talk in their own alphabet (your suit translates) and trade from what they gather. Farm, hunt, build a sealed base, run power, and fly ships you built yourself. Play alone or co-op with friends, on your own dedicated server if you like.
